data.one_liner: A Dart library package to produce playing cards layouts
data.what_it_does: Calculates coordinates and angles for an array of sized objects to form horizontal, vertical, or fan playing card layouts. It returns a list of positioning data while leaving the actual rendering up to the developer.
use_when: You are building a card game and need to calculate card positions for hands or layouts.
You want to arrange cards in horizontal, vertical, or fan formations using custom UI or CustomPainter.
avoid_when: You need a complete widget set with pre-built card graphics and animations.
You are not building card-based layouts.
strengths: Provides multiple layout variations including horizontal, vertical, and fan.
Decouples layout calculations from presentation, allowing use with Flutter widgets or CustomPainter.
weaknesses: Very limited documentation and configuration details beyond basic code snippets.
Does not handle rendering or UI elements directly.
